description: This file contains the implementation of the DETR object detection model, including its main class, the loss criterion, auxiliary components like MLP, and building functions, along with related imports and helper functions.

classes.name: DETR
classes.description: Main object detection model implementing the Transformer-based architecture with methods for forward propagation and auxiliary loss handling.

classes.name: SetCriterion
classes.description: Loss computation class for training DETR, including matching, classification, box, mask, and auxiliary losses.

classes.name: MLP
classes.description: A simple multi-layer perceptron used within the DETR model for box regression.

classes.name: PostProcess
classes.description: Converts raw model outputs into COCO API-compatible detection results with bounding boxes, scores, and labels.

methods.name: forward(self, outputs, target_sizes)
methods.description: Performs the forward pass of the DETR model, including feature extraction, transformer processing, and output prediction.

methods.name: _set_aux_loss(self, outputs_class, outputs_coord)
methods.description: Creates auxiliary outputs for intermediate decoder layers for auxiliary loss calculation.

methods.name: loss_labels(self, outputs, targets, indices, num_boxes, log=True)
methods.description: Computes the classification loss (cross-entropy) between predicted logits and target labels.

methods.name: loss_cardinality(self, outputs, targets, indices, num_boxes)
methods.description: Calculates the error in the number of predicted non-empty boxes for monitoring purposes.

methods.name: loss_boxes(self, outputs, targets, indices, num_boxes)
methods.description: Computes bounding box regression losses including L1 and GIoU losses.

methods.name: loss_masks(self, outputs, targets, indices, num_boxes)
methods.description: Calculates mask-related losses including focal loss and dice loss.

methods.name: get_loss(self, loss, outputs, targets, indices, num_boxes, **kwargs)
methods.description: Dispatches the appropriate loss function based on loss name.

methods.name: forward(self, outputs, targets)
methods.description: Executes the loss calculation over model outputs and ground-truth targets, including auxiliary losses if enabled.

methods.name: forward(self, samples: NestedTensor)
methods.description: Transforms raw model outputs into detection results formatted for COCO evaluation.

methods.name: forward(self, x)
methods.description: Passes input tensor through the MLP layers.

methods.name: build(args)
methods.description: Builds the DETR model, criterion, and postprocessors using supplied arguments and configurations.
